commit d0a323fea1e48f77f1836cbccaafe6f48ceea847
Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
AuthorDate: Sat May 3 13:26:07 2025 +0300
Commit:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
CommitDate: Sat May 3 13:26:07 2025 +0300

    Bug 783526 - remove NS_ERROR_SMTP_TEMP_SIZE_EXCEEDED. r=babolivier
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D246839

diff --git a/mailnews/compose/src/MimeMessageUtils.sys.mjs b/mailnews/compose/src/MimeMessageUtils.sys.mjs
index b982d4d25fb..d6c9e3e08cb 100644
--- a/mailnews/compose/src/MimeMessageUtils.sys.mjs
+++ b/mailnews/compose/src/MimeMessageUtils.sys.mjs
@@ -44,7 +44,6 @@ export var MsgUtils = {
 
   NS_MSG_ERROR_ATTACHING_FILE: generateNSError(12570),
 
-  NS_ERROR_SMTP_TEMP_SIZE_EXCEEDED: generateNSError(12586),
   NS_ERROR_SMTP_PERM_SIZE_EXCEEDED_2: generateNSError(12588),
 
   NS_ERROR_SMTP_AUTH_CHANGE_ENCRYPT_TO_PLAIN_NO_SSL: generateNSError(12594),
@@ -836,7 +835,6 @@ export var MsgUtils = {
       [this.NS_MSG_UNABLE_TO_SEND_LATER]: "unableToSendLater",
       [this.NS_ERROR_BUT_DONT_SHOW_ALERT]: "dontShowAlert",
       [this.NS_MSG_ERROR_ATTACHING_FILE]: "errorAttachingFile",
-      [this.NS_ERROR_SMTP_TEMP_SIZE_EXCEEDED]: "smtpTooManyRecipients",
       [this.NS_ERROR_SMTP_PERM_SIZE_EXCEEDED_2]: "smtpPermSizeExceeded2",
       [Cr.NS_ERROR_UNKNOWN_HOST]: "smtpSendFailedUnknownServer",
       [Cr.NS_ERROR_UNKNOWN_PROXY_HOST]: "smtpSendFailedUnknownServer",
diff --git a/mailnews/compose/src/SmtpClient.sys.mjs b/mailnews/compose/src/SmtpClient.sys.mjs
index e64be61ccf1..52949d4bd12 100644
--- a/mailnews/compose/src/SmtpClient.sys.mjs
+++ b/mailnews/compose/src/SmtpClient.sys.mjs
@@ -547,7 +547,6 @@ export class SmtpClient {
       const errorName = MsgUtils.getErrorStringName(nsError);
       if (
         [
-          MsgUtils.NS_ERROR_SMTP_TEMP_SIZE_EXCEEDED,
           MsgUtils.NS_ERROR_SMTP_PERM_SIZE_EXCEEDED_2,
           MsgUtils.NS_ERROR_SENDING_FROM_COMMAND,
           MsgUtils.NS_ERROR_SENDING_DATA_COMMAND,
@@ -1214,7 +1213,7 @@ export class SmtpClient {
       }
       if (command.statusCode == 452 || command.statusCode == 451) {
         // @see https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5321#section-4.5.3.1.10
-        errorCode = MsgUtils.NS_ERROR_SMTP_TEMP_SIZE_EXCEEDED;
+        errorCode = "smtpTooManyRecipients";
       }
       this._onNsError(errorCode, command.data, null, command.statusCode);
       return;
diff --git a/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.cpp b/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.cpp
index c9a9c2d35c8..5f6269040fc 100644
--- a/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.cpp
+++ b/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.cpp
@@ -27,8 +27,6 @@ const char* errorStringNameForErrorCode(nsresult aCode) {
       return "dontShowAlert";
     case NS_MSG_ERROR_ATTACHING_FILE:
       return "errorAttachingFile";
-    case NS_ERROR_SMTP_TEMP_SIZE_EXCEEDED:
-      return "smtpTooManyRecipients";
     case NS_ERROR_SMTP_PERM_SIZE_EXCEEDED_2:
       return "smtpPermSizeExceeded2";
     case NS_ERROR_SMTP_AUTH_CHANGE_ENCRYPT_TO_PLAIN_NO_SSL:
diff --git a/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.h b/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.h
index a323fe0aae3..a4c70e09ece 100644
--- a/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.h
+++ b/mailnews/compose/src/nsComposeStrings.h
@@ -23,7 +23,6 @@
 
 #define NS_MSG_ERROR_ATTACHING_FILE                 NS_MSG_GENERATE_FAILURE(12570)
 
-#define NS_ERROR_SMTP_TEMP_SIZE_EXCEEDED            NS_MSG_GENERATE_FAILURE(12586)
 #define NS_ERROR_SMTP_PERM_SIZE_EXCEEDED_2          NS_MSG_GENERATE_FAILURE(12588)
 
 #define NS_ERROR_SMTP_AUTH_CHANGE_ENCRYPT_TO_PLAIN_NO_SSL  NS_MSG_GENERATE_FAILURE(12594)
title: Bug 783526 - remove NS_ERROR_SMTP_TEMP_SIZE_EXCEEDED. r=babolivier
